verses.kjv: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
verses.web: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

verses.kjv: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
verses.web: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

verses.kjv: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
verses.web: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

verses.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.web: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

verses.kjv: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
verses.web: ‘Yahweh bless you, and keep you.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
verses.web: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

verses.kjv: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.web: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”

verses.kjv: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the Lord seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.
verses.web: But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”

verses.kjv: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
verses.web: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

verses.kjv: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.web: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.

verses.kjv: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
verses.web: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

verses.kjv: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
verses.web: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

verses.kjv: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters. He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake. Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me. Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over. Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
verses.web: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake. Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me. You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over. Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.

verses.kjv: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
verses.web: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

verses.kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD , all ye lands.
verses.web: Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!

verses.kjv: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
verses.web: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

verses.kjv: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.web: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.web: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
verses.web: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

verses.kjv: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
verses.web: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

verses.kjv: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verses.web: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

verses.kjv: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
verses.web: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

verses.kjv: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
verses.web: For to us a child is born. To us a son is given; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful, Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

verses.kjv: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
verses.web: But those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

verses.kjv: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD , thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
verses.web: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

verses.kjv: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
verses.web: Yahweh prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

verses.kjv: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
verses.web: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

verses.kjv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verses.web: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes; for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

verses.kjv: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
verses.web: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

verses.kjv: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
verses.web: You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.

verses.kjv: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
verses.web: Pray like this: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

verses.kjv: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
verses.web: Pray like this: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done, as in heaven, so on earth. Give us today our daily bread. Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’

verses.kjv: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
verses.web: Therefore whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

verses.kjv: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.web: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

verses.kjv: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.web: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
verses.web: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’

verses.kjv: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
verses.web: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

verses.kjv: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
verses.web: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

verses.kjv: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
verses.web: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

verses.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
verses.web: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

verses.kjv: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
verses.web: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

verses.kjv: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
verses.web: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

verses.kjv: Jesus wept.
verses.web: Jesus wept.

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
verses.web: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

verses.kjv: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
verses.web: If you love me, keep my commandments.

verses.kjv: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
verses.web: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”

verses.kjv: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
verses.web: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

verses.kjv: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.web: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.kjv: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
verses.web: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose.

verses.kjv: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.web: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

verses.kjv: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
verses.web: Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

verses.kjv: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
verses.web: Love is patient and is kind; love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

verses.kjv: Let all your things be done with charity.
verses.web: Let all that you do be done in love.

verses.kjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
verses.web: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

verses.kjv: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
verses.web: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

verses.kjv: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.
verses.web: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

verses.kjv: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
verses.web: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

verses.kjv: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
verses.web: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

verses.kjv: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
verses.web: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

verses.kjv: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
verses.web: I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
verses.web: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men,

verses.kjv: Rejoice evermore. Pray without ceasing. In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
verses.web: Rejoice always. Pray without ceasing. In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

verses.kjv: Pray without ceasing.
verses.web: Pray without ceasing.

verses.kjv: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
verses.web: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

verses.kjv: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
verses.web: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

verses.kjv: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
verses.web: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
verses.web: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

verses.kjv: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
verses.web: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

verses.kjv: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
verses.web: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

verses.kjv: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.web: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

verses.kjv: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
verses.web: Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God, and knows God.

verses.kjv: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
verses.web: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

verses.kjv: We love him, because he first loved us.
verses.web: We love him, because he first loved us.

verses.kjv: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
verses.web: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed, and were created!”

stories.title: God Makes the World
stories.text: In the beginning there was only God. He spoke, and light came. He made sky, land, seas, plants, sun, moon, stars, birds, fish, and animals. Last of all He made people. Then He rested, and it was very good.

stories.title: The Garden and the Fall
stories.text: God placed the first man and woman in a good garden and gave them one command. They listened to the serpent instead, and sin entered the world. God still promised that a Savior would come.

stories.title: Noah and the Ark
stories.text: The world grew violent, but Noah walked with God. God told him to build a great ark. Rain fell, the earth was covered, and God kept Noah’s family and the animals safe. After the flood God set a rainbow in the cloud.

stories.title: God Calls Abraham
stories.text: God called Abram to leave his country. He promised land, a family, and blessing for all nations. Abraham believed God, and God counted it as righteousness.

stories.title: Isaac, the Promised Son
stories.text: Abraham and Sarah waited many years. God kept His word and gave them Isaac. The promise of a great family moved forward through this child.

stories.title: Jacob Becomes Israel
stories.text: Jacob ran, wrestled, and learned to cling to God. God named him Israel. From his twelve sons came the tribes of Israel.

stories.title: Joseph in Egypt
stories.text: Brothers sold Joseph, but God was with him in Egypt. He became a wise helper in a famine. What others meant for harm, God used to save many lives.

stories.title: Moses and the Burning Bush
stories.text: God heard Israel groaning in Egypt. From a bush that burned but was not eaten, He sent Moses: “I AM THAT I AM.” Moses went to Pharaoh with God’s word.

stories.title: Through the Sea
stories.text: God brought Israel out with a mighty hand. He made a path through the sea. The people walked on dry ground, and they sang to the Lord.

stories.title: The Ten Commandments
stories.text: At the mountain God spoke ten words for His people: worship Him only, keep His name holy, rest, honor father and mother, and love your neighbor. His law shows His heart.

stories.title: Jericho’s Walls
stories.text: After Moses, Joshua led Israel. They marched around Jericho as God said. On the seventh day the walls fell, and the people learned that the Lord fights for them.

stories.title: Ruth Stays
stories.text: Ruth would not leave Naomi. She gleaned in Boaz’s field. God folded this faithful stranger into the family line of King David—and of Jesus.

stories.title: Samuel Listens
stories.text: The boy Samuel heard his name in the night. Eli taught him to say, “Speak, LORD; for thy servant heareth.” Samuel grew into a prophet who listened.

stories.title: David and Goliath
stories.text: A shepherd boy faced a giant with a sling and with the name of the Lord. David would not let Israel be mocked. The battle was the Lord’s.

stories.title: David the King
stories.text: God took David from the sheepfolds to the throne. He promised David a house that would last. From that line would come the forever King.

stories.title: Solomon Asks for Wisdom
stories.text: When God offered Solomon a gift, he asked for an understanding heart to judge the people. God gave wisdom, and the temple was built in Jerusalem.

stories.title: Elijah on the Mountain
stories.text: On Mount Carmel Elijah called the people back to the Lord. Fire fell. The people cried, “The LORD, he is the God.”

stories.title: Daniel and the Lions
stories.text: Daniel prayed with his windows open even when a law forbade it. God shut the lions’ mouths. The king learned that Daniel’s God is living.

stories.title: Esther Speaks Up
stories.text: Esther was queen in a far palace when her people were in danger. She fasted, went before the king, and was used to save many lives.

stories.title: Jonah and the Great Fish
stories.text: Jonah ran from God’s call. A storm, a fish, and a second chance taught him that God’s mercy is wide—even for Nineveh.

stories.title: Jesus Is Born
stories.text: In Bethlehem a baby was laid in a manger. Angels told shepherds that a Saviour was born. Wise men followed a star. God had come near.

stories.title: Jesus Is Baptized
stories.text: Jesus came to the Jordan. The Spirit came like a dove, and the Father’s voice said He was the beloved Son. His public work began.

stories.title: Jesus Calms the Storm
stories.text: Waves filled the boat. The disciples were afraid. Jesus stood and said, “Peace, be still.” Wind and sea obeyed Him.

stories.title: A Crowd Is Fed
stories.text: A boy’s lunch of bread and fish was placed in Jesus’ hands. He gave thanks, broke it, and thousands ate. There were baskets left over.

stories.title: The Lost Sheep
stories.text: A shepherd leaves the ninety-nine to find one lost sheep. He carries it home and calls friends to rejoice. That is how heaven feels when one sinner turns back.

stories.title: The Kind Neighbor
stories.text: A man lay hurt on the road. Two passed by. A Samaritan stopped, bound the wounds, and paid for care. Jesus said, “Go, and do thou likewise.”

stories.title: The Son Who Came Home
stories.text: A son wasted his share and came home hungry. The father ran, embraced him, and made a feast. The older brother had to learn the father’s mercy too.

stories.title: Jesus and the Children
stories.text: People brought little ones to Jesus. The disciples tried to send them away. Jesus welcomed them and said the kingdom belongs to such as these.

stories.title: The Last Supper
stories.text: On the night He was betrayed, Jesus broke bread and shared the cup with His friends. He gave a new covenant in His blood, and He washed their feet.

stories.title: The Cross and the Empty Tomb
stories.text: Jesus died on a cross for sinners. Friends laid Him in a tomb. On the third day the stone was rolled away. He is risen, as He said.

stories.title: The Spirit Comes
stories.text: At Pentecost the Holy Spirit filled the believers. They spoke the good news in many tongues. The church was born, and thousands believed.

stories.title: Paul Sent Out
stories.text: Saul the persecutor met Jesus on the road and became Paul the servant. He carried the gospel to city after city and wrote letters the church still reads.

qualities.name: Love
qualities.note: Love seeks the good of another. God loved us first.

qualities.name: Joy
qualities.note: Joy is gladness in the Lord, not only when things go our way.

qualities.name: Peace
qualities.note: Peace is quiet trust, and peacemakers help others rest too.

qualities.name: Patience
qualities.note: Patience waits without snapping. Scripture also calls it longsuffering.

qualities.name: Kindness
qualities.note: Kindness is tender help. Be kind, tenderhearted, and ready to forgive.

qualities.name: Goodness
qualities.note: Goodness chooses what is right even when no one is watching.

qualities.name: Faith
qualities.note: Faith trusts the Lord with the whole heart and leans not on ourselves.

qualities.name: Gentleness
qualities.note: Gentleness is strength under control. A soft answer turns away wrath.

qualities.name: Self-control
qualities.note: Self-control holds the tongue, the hands, and the wants.

qualities.name: Courage
qualities.note: Courage is not loudness. It is obeying God when you feel small.

qualities.name: Honesty
qualities.note: Honesty tells the truth and keeps its word.

qualities.name: Humility
qualities.note: Humility walks low before God and does not put others down.

qualities.name: Gratitude
qualities.note: Gratitude says thank you to God, because His mercy lasts.

qualities.name: Obedience
qualities.note: Obedience is doing what is asked, as unto the Lord.

qualities.name: Mercy
qualities.note: Mercy does not give the hurt someone earned. It stoops to help.

qualities.name: Wisdom
qualities.note: Wisdom starts with trusting the Lord, then choosing the good path.

qualities.name: Diligence
qualities.note: Diligence works heartily, as to the Lord, not only when watched.

qualities.name: Forgiveness
qualities.note: Forgiveness lets go of a debt, as God in Christ forgave us.

qualities.name: Hope
qualities.note: Hope looks forward because God is faithful, even in hard days.

qualities.name: Reverence
qualities.note: Reverence honors God as worthy of glory, honor, and power.
